Losing streak? Size DOWN, not up. 🧠

Most traders in a drawdown do the opposite: down -5R in a week, they double the size to win it back faster. Two more normal losses at double risk and the account is at -9R instead of -7R. The strategy didn't change, only the damage did. Losing streaks are part of any edge. Cutting size during a drawdown keeps you in the game long enough for the edge to show up again.

1️⃣ After -5R from the peak, cut risk per trade in half
2️⃣ Go back to full size only after you recover +3R at half size
3️⃣ Never size up to recover a loss
